subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be resolved as documentation/help for the existing TUI multiline keybindings, or should OpenClaw add a supported configurable TUI send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: The core Shift+Enter behavior is dependency-backed already, but a configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter preference would add a new OpenClaw config or CLI contract and should not be introduced without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior
options.body: Update TUI docs and `/help` to list Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limits, and the fallback behavior without adding config yet.

options.title: Add TUI Preference
options.body: Introduce a narrow OpenClaw config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with focused tests and upgrade-safe docs.

options.title: Fold Into Composer Strategy
options.body: Track TUI keybindings together with the WebChat send-shortcut preference so all composer surfaces share one product direction.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and `/help` to list Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limits, and the fallback behavior without adding config yet.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter already scoped this issue as remaining docs/config product work in the issue discussion and has related TUI keybinding history.
